title: Let AI answer your website chat
blurb: Link Conversation AI to your chat widget so visitors get instant replies.

steps.title: Open Conversation AI
steps.body: Head to **AI Agents** and click **Conversation AI**. This is where your chat bot lives.

steps.title: Open your bot
steps.body: Open your bot, or create one. Give it your services, areas, hours and prices so it answers accurately.
steps.tip: Add your website and FAQs to the Knowledge Base so the bot can look things up.

steps.title: Turn on Live Chat
steps.body: In the bot settings, make sure **Live Chat** is one of its channels.

steps.title: Choose the mode
steps.body: Pick **Suggestive** to have it draft replies for you to approve, or **Auto-Pilot** to reply on its own. Save.

steps.title: Check your widget type
steps.body: Your chat widget should be a **Live Chat** or all-in-one type, installed on your site. See **Install the chat widget on your website** in the Guide.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Open your website in a private window and ask the bot a question a customer would. Adjust its instructions if the answer is off.
